info.title: PlainShow dashboard
info.description: Your account, the services you can use, the server's health and the weather.

get.description: Your account, role, the services you can use and your capabilities.
Every turned-on service you can open, with its address and version.
Processor, memory, storage, temperature and uptime of the Pi.
Places matching a name, with their coordinates (Open-Meteo).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: A place name, at least two letters

get.description: The weather now, the next 24 hours and seven days, with sunrise and sunset. From SMHI in the Nordic countries and Open-Meteo elsewhere. Temperatures in °C, wind in m/s, rain in mm. Conditions: clear, partly, cloudy, overcast, fog, drizzle, rain, heavy-rain, sleet, snow, thunder.
SMHI's yellow, orange and red warnings at or within 80 km of a point in Sweden, nearest first; `here` is true inside the warned area.

200.description: `{warnings: [{level, event, title, text, areas, here, km, start, end}]}`

get.description: The last hours of rain radar (two unless `hours`, up to six, says otherwise), ten minutes apart. SMHI's Swedish composite (PNG images in SWEREF 99 TM, with their grid) where it covers the place, RainViewer map tiles elsewhere.

parameters.name: hours
parameters.description: How many hours back, 1 to 6 (SMHI only)
